'''Lowbacca's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|bronze]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] created and wielded by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lowbacca]] during his time studying at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].

==Description==
[[Lowbacca]]'s lightsaber was a molten [[Color/Legends|bronze]] colored [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] constructed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Lowbacca. [[Gender/Legends|He]] created the weapon using [[Computer/Legends|computer]] components found in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. These components included a [[Focusing lens/Legends|focusing lens]] and an [[enhancement jewel]] that he used as the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]].<ref name="Lightsabers" /> When ignited, the blade was similar in shape to a [[Club/Legends|club]]<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege]]''</ref> and nearly as wide as the 15-year-old [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo's]] [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="Return to Ord Mantell">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell]]''</ref>

==History==
===Construction===
{{Quote|He has already assembled the components he intends to use for his lightsaber. The primary construction on his instrument is complete, and he has only to tune it now.|[[M-TD]]|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
After Lowbacca, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and Jaina Solo's [[Raid on GemDiver Station|abduction]] by the [[Second Imperium]]'s [[Shadow Academy]] and their rescue by [[Tenel Ka Djo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="Lightsabers" /> in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Skywalker determined that his four young students were ready to construct their own lightsabers. After the lessons the students had learned at the Shadow Academy about taking the weapons seriously, he wanted them to be prepared for the [[Second Imperium Crisis|growing threat]] of the Second Imperium.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

Because of his passion for computers, Lowbacca chose to search the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] control room in the [[Jedi Praxeum]]'s Great Temple for components to use in his lightsaber. In the control room he found a flat focusing lens and a spherical enhancement jewel to use as the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] in his lightsaber. After assembling the components he needed, Lowbacca aided Tenel Ka in searching a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] for an appropriate crystal for her own lightsaber before making the final tune ups to the weapon.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lowbacca's lightsaber first appeared in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'' written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], in which the [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights|series']] four main characters constructed their first lightsabers.<ref name="Lightsabers" /> The lightsaber was first pictured on the cover of ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Darkest Knight]]'', the next book in the ''Young Jedi Knights'' series published later the same year.<ref name="Darkest Knight" />
